exa_billing: No Exa; native Codex subscription search and unauthenticated public HTTPS
web_freshness: Native live-search candidates; evidence fetched directly with robots checks and immutable raw snapshots

nav_source.scope: Complete NAV feed; exact employer/subunit identifiers; Finn excluded; source zero is not company-wide absence

bootstrap_manifest.since: first available event; no date filter

nav_source.job_queries: Derived afresh for every company from the shared source catalogue; no prior company hiring result reused

cutoff_scope: Explicit claim date admission; undated live pages are not a historical archive

quality_admission.note: Production completion is not quality certification; independently review the sealed artifacts.

hiring_observations.note: Completed NAV source checks are separate from populated hiring information and positive recruitment signals.

model_billing: Configured provider; actual subscription/API billing and token-based API equivalent reported separately

cache.semantics: HTTP GETs revalidated across runs; no TTL trust; extraction cache target-entity/identity/prompt/model/schema/cutoff scoped

cost_scope.subscription: Actual incremental model API charge is zero; fixed subscription excluded; API equivalent is a separate estimate
cost_scope.external_source: Connector bills are unknown, not zero; no new credit purchases
cost_scope.source_setup: Shared source setup included in runtime and physical requests; cache mode declared

memory_note: RSS sum sampled every 2 seconds for the runner and its child processes; shared pages may be counted more than once
